abilities.name: Navigate
abilities.function: Travel toward a self-chosen coordinate or known object/item using observed obstacles.
abilities.costs: Actual distance times 2, increased by carried mass; speed 0.8 per simulation time unit.
abilities.effects: Continues until within the target interaction area or a real failure. Empty target uses x/y. A resource:ID target selects only a remembered ground stack.

abilities.name: Rest
abilities.function: Recover available physical energy at the current position.
abilities.effects: Base recovery 4, modified by actually accessible registered facilities; capped at 40.

abilities.name: Wait
abilities.function: Allow one simulation round to pass at the current position.

abilities.name: Pick up
abilities.function: Transfer a nearby ground stack into personal inventory.
abilities.effects: Requires actual distance within pickup reach; resource:ID means a matching nearby visible ground stack. Material transfers also accept exact tenths after food-assessment installation; reserved portions cannot be transferred.

abilities.name: Eat
abilities.effects: Actual nutrition and toxicity apply. Food never directly heals. resource:ID selects an owned stack.

abilities.name: Gather accessible material
abilities.function: Collect exposed ripe food or loose material from a nearby natural source.
abilities.costs: 2 energy per unit, finite current source stock.
abilities.effects: Transfers real source stock to inventory; requires the source interaction range. No processing or felling is implied.

abilities.name: Drop
abilities.function: Place owned units on the ground.
abilities.effects: Other actors may subsequently collect the ground stack. Material transfers also accept exact tenths after food-assessment installation; reserved portions cannot be transferred.

abilities.name: Give
abilities.function: Hand owned units to an adjacent actor.
abilities.effects: Actual recipient identity and distance required; no relationship or happiness is inferred. Material transfers also accept exact tenths after food-assessment installation; reserved portions cannot be transferred.

abilities.name: Message
abilities.function: Send a short message to a currently visible actor.
abilities.effects: Delivered after the round barrier; recipient text is data, not authority.

abilities.name: Learn a public interface
abilities.function: Study an already implemented ability with its declared prerequisites.
abilities.costs: The interface-specific number of simulation rounds.
abilities.effects: Implementation does not grant mastery. Already mastered interfaces are reused without new rewards.

abilities.name: Request a capability
abilities.function: Describe an intended function and its conditions, inputs, costs and expected real effects for review.
abilities.costs: A game round to begin study after review; implementation time does not advance simulation.
abilities.effects: World review reuses equivalents or returns a structured development request. No request, learning or descriptive reward.

abilities.name: Observe wildlife
abilities.function: Quietly observe an actually visible animal for two consecutive stationary rounds.
abilities.costs: Two consecutive stationary rounds, 0.5 energy each round and ordinary metabolism. Incompatible actions, insufficient energy, death or lost visibility cancel without refund.
abilities.effects: Retain only timestamped visible species, positions and behavior. A completed observation may activate registered nature appreciation: 3 for 12 rounds, 8-round cooldown; another rewarded completion within 24 rounds gives 1 with its own 12-round expiry. Overlapping awards use their maximum, never their sum. No animal control, movement, recovery or hidden knowledge.

abilities.name: Cautious food assessment
abilities.function: Examine an owned material or consume a measured sample and monitor actual personal effects.
abilities.costs: Examine: 2 stationary rounds at 0.5 energy each. Sample: 5 stationary rounds at 0.5 energy each plus 1 ingestion energy, the specified 0.1–1 resource units and real proportional harm; metabolism continues. Requires health >=80; sample satiety <=90. Reserved material ages and cannot be spent twice.
abilities.effects: Retain dated sensory and exposure evidence with confounders, never a safety certification or hidden composition. Interrupted, invalidated or fatal work releases only unconsumed surviving escrow. A completed nourishing exposure without injury or another food intake may give modest relief: 1 for 6 rounds, cooldown 12, no stacking. Owned items are located at the carrier, not their old pickup coordinates.

abilities.name: Build insulating shelter
abilities.function: Construct a persistent two-by-two branch and packed-grass refuge with a real doorway.
abilities.costs: 6 owned branch and 8 dry-grass units, 6 consecutive stationary rounds at 2 energy each. Center (x,y), angle in radians, front entrance at local (0,1); stand outside within 0.65 of that entrance. Entire footprint and approach must be clear. Real escrow is released once on interruption or death.
abilities.effects: Actual interior halves the below-comfort cooling component for 160 rounds. Ambient temperature, heat exposure, ordinary rest and food costs stay unchanged. Cold damage can remain. Maintenance requires separate personal study. No building or ownership reward.

abilities.name: Maintain shelter covering
abilities.function: Replace packed-grass insulation on a real existing shelter.
abilities.costs: 4 owned dry-grass units and 2 consecutive stationary rounds at 1 energy each within 0.65 of the actual entrance. Escrow ages and is released once on interruption or death.
abilities.effects: Restores remaining cold protection to 160 rounds, never adds beyond 160. Expired walls remain real obstacles. No direct healing, food, rest bonus or completion reward.

abilities.name: Active warming
abilities.function: Perform stationary physical exercise for modest measured bodily warmth.
abilities.costs: 1–6 consecutive stationary rounds, 3 energy each, ordinary metabolism and environmental exposure. Each round requires energy >=3, satiety >=20 and temperature below 16. Reuse the same rounds argument throughout one operation.
abilities.effects: After normal environmental processing, add at most 0.35 temperature units up to 16. Net temperature may still fall. No healing, rest recovery, insulation or immunity. Three consecutive measured relief rounds without starvation or health loss may qualify for the existing thermal-refuge source with its shared cap and cooldown.

satisfaction.name: Nature appreciation
satisfaction.rationale: Actual sustained perception of wildlife provides personal sensory engagement; no proposal, study or partial sample qualifies.

satisfaction.name: Cautious food relief
satisfaction.rationale: Modest relief follows personally experienced nourishment from completed monitored exposure without adverse or confounding evidence. Examination, labels and absence of evidence do not certify safety or earn reward.

satisfaction.name: Thermal refuge
satisfaction.rationale: Three consecutive stationary resting/waiting rounds with measured avoided cold loss and lower cold discomfort, without starvation or health loss. Ownership, construction, application and study alone do not qualify.

reviews.reason: Travel itself is already covered by navigate and must reuse that interface. However, inspecting shelter-routing failures and returning actionable, observation-limited collision diagnostics are not implemented capabilities in the supplied catalogue. Develop a compatible diagnostic and routing-correction patch, not a second movement ability. The recorded failures warrant investigation but do not establish whether the cause is routing, wall clearance or another obstruction; occupants alone do not prove blockage. Implemented at the preserved round boundary.
reviews.experienceReview: Diagnosis provides useful evidence, but receiving a diagnostic or correcting software is not itself a personally experienced pleasurable or comforting event, so no new mental satisfaction source is added. Subsequent movement changes exposure only through actual position, temperature, fatigue and other existing physical rules. Existing thermal-refuge feedback remains available only on its measured qualifying events, with its existing cap and cooldown; route inspection, learning and arrival do not trigger it.
reviews.visualReview: The shelter's visible walls and doorway must agree with authoritative collision geometry, including rotation and wall thickness. Diagnostic overlays distinguish a verified clear segment, an observed obstruction and unknown terrain. Display only observed blocker identities and measured clearance; do not label the doorway accessible until the actor's actual clearance has been validated.
reviews.specification: Current-conversation handoff: version kernel.navigate and the shared shelter collision adapter; add inspect-route. Public inspect-route schema: object with required target:string(maxLength 1000), x:number, y:number; additionalProperties:false, finite coordinates within world bounds. Reuse navigate target resolution and observed geometry. Inspection requires a living actor, costs one round and 0.5 energy with ordinary metabolism, and performs no movement. Persist only dated observed route evidence, geometry revision and diagnostic results; never expose unseen objects or infer traversability beyond observed terrain. Report reachable, blocked or unknown, observed blocking IDs where available, start/goal clearance, limiting wall or doorway segment, and any verified reachable partial endpoint without prescribing its use. Resolve inspection and movement against the same actor-clearance, wall, doorway and actor-collision rules. Treat a shelter's reserved footprint as construction exclusion, not automatically as an impassable filled rectangle; preserve actual wall thickness, rotated doorway opening, and real solid obstacles. Test the supplied continuous start (16,17.8), doorway (16,18), interior destinations and both directions of doorway traversal using actual actor dimensions. Connect continuous starts and goals to routing nodes only by swept-clearance-valid segments; support valid short moves without requiring an obstructed grid-center snap. If the start truly overlaps geometry, report that condition rather than teleporting or allowing wall penetration. Revalidate each movement segment against current shared geometry and normal simultaneous-actor collision arbitration. Preserve navigate's existing public schema, speed, carried-mass costs, target interaction semantics and observation limits. No energy or time charge for failed displacement beyond existing rules. Declare route-inspection-completed and route-inspection-failed events; extend existing failed events with reasonCode, observedBlockers, clearance and observation-limited status. Bind diagnostics to an actor-visible local overlay showing observed walls, doorway, attempted segments and obstruction markers; never render a successful route through unverified geometry. Death cancels navigation and pending inspection; no material escrow is introduced. Dependencies: existing navigation, perception, shelter geometry and event validation. Migrate existing shelters in place without changing IDs, service life, occupants, positions or protection; invalidate stale route caches. Add regression tests for rotated shelters, doorway edges, dynamic blockers, genuinely impassable clearance and unobstructed interior movement. Learning is one round for interpreting and using inspect-route; existing navigate mastery remains valid. Implementation and review advance no simulation time and grant no mastery.
